purpose: Per-file staging receipt for the corrected product-name cutover. Apply this manifest to the next coordinated desktop/web release only after both platform artifacts and public routes pass release preflight.

replacementRules.scope: visible copy, release metadata, installer display names, user-facing documentation
new canonical filenames, update-feed filenames, canonical web aliases, and new client settings

compatibilityContracts: chatgrid:// and indiginous:// deep links remain accepted by the cutover release
/chatgrid/, /indiginous/, and their websocket/auth aliases remain served until the cutover release is installed across the supported population
chat_grid_native import paths, CHGRID_* environment variables, chat-grid systemd units, database names, and existing storage keys remain readable so updates do not strand installations
old installer/update-feed URLs resolve to the same next Indiginous artifact and checksum

feedAliases.rule: All aliases must serve identical Indiginous 0.4.7 metadata, download filename, artifact bytes, and SHA-256 before publication.

requiredProof: public canonical and legacy URL checks
